patterns: Parent-ministry one-liners dominate: Department of Border Management = MHA (APPSC 2018), RAW = Cabinet Secretariat, Coast Guard = MoD.
Force-border pairs and raising years recur: BSF = Pakistan + Bangladesh, raised 1965; ITBP China; SSB Nepal-Bhutan; Assam Rifles Myanmar.
CDS facts are asked as 'not true' items: adviser to Defence Minister, age limit 65, not DAC chairman.
AP angle: Greyhounds = anti-leftist-extremism force; People's War Group based in Andhra Pradesh; Operation Mahadev near Dachigam (APPSC 2025).
App MCQs are broadly sound and match PYQ style, but add many current-affairs operations, laws and multi-statement sets.
